description: Na₄Sc₂Si₄O₁₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.92 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.48 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.22 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.20 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-52°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three ScO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-45°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.69 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-51°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three ScO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-47°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sc, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sc, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sc, and one Si atom.
